_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

From the Bottom#000.src: An'! The best part! The idiot came back with a crumpled wrist and this HORRIFIED look- Musta gotten on the Hive witch's bad side!
From the Bottom#000.dst: それに！ここからが傑作だ！あのバカ、手首をぐしゃぐしゃにして真っ青な顔で戻ってきやがった――巣の魔女を怒らせたに違いねえ！

From the Bottom#001.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy [{~} Troll Hair]. Nakoba is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#001.dst: {p} で [{~} Troll Hair] を買いたい人を探す。Nakoba は {~}, {~}, -{~} にいる

From the Bottom#002.src: Ah, hey there, human! I'm certain you've noticed the bazaar down here. It's a point of pride for the Dwarves- biggest marketplace of all the Dwarf cities!
From the Bottom#002.dst: あ、やあ、人間さん！下のこのバザーにはもう気づいたよね。ドワーフの誇りなんだ――ドワーフの街で一番大きな市場さ！
From the Bottom#002.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#003.src: Specialty items you can't find anywhere else- All sorts of strange, wonderful, unique things. I've been looking for a few sundry items myself here.
From the Bottom#003.dst: よそでは手に入らない特別な品ばかり――奇妙で素敵で唯一無二の物がいろいろ。僕もここでちょっとした物を探してるんだ。
From the Bottom#003.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#004.src: It's almost all barter, unlike the merchants above that deal in that shiny stuff. Which is...a little unfortunate for me, in a way.
From the Bottom#004.dst: 上のピカピカのお金を扱う商人と違って、ここはほとんど物々交換。それが…僕にはちょっと不運でね。
From the Bottom#004.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#005.src: You see, I'm a historian by trade, but what I'm really after now is some Troll Hair. See, I really like the sme- er. It's good and sturdy for binding books- wait a second!
From the Bottom#005.dst: 実は僕、本業は歴史学者なんだけど、今本当に欲しいのは Troll Hair なんだ。あの匂いがたまらな――えっと。本を綴じるのに丈夫でいいんだよ――ちょっと待って！
From the Bottom#005.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#006.src: YOU have some? Phenomenal! I can never get it myself- was never much of a fighter. Um, here! Let me trade you that, for...this!
From the Bottom#006.dst: 君、持ってるの？すごい！僕には手に入らなくてさ――戦うのは苦手で。えっと、はい！それと…これを交換しよう！
From the Bottom#006.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#007.src: A Decorative Bottlecap Set! These were hard to come by, but I've got two sets of them anyways. Check them out! You'll learn a lot. Thank you very much, by the way!
From the Bottom#007.dst: 飾り王冠のセット！なかなか手に入らないけど、どうせ二セットあるから。見てみて！勉強になるよ。ところで、本当にありがとう！
From the Bottom#007.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#008.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Decorative Bottlecap Collection]. Dobile is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#008.dst: {p} で [Decorative Bottlecap Collection] を買いたい人を探す。Dobile は {~}, {~}, -{~} にいる

From the Bottom#009.src: Minerals for sale! Minerals for sale! Come get your rare metals! We've got Kanderstone, Wynnic Copper, genuine {p} Sandstone, real Voidstone from the {p}!
From the Bottom#009.dst: 鉱石売ってるよ！鉱石売ってるよ！希少金属はいかが！Kanderstone、Wynnic Copper、本物の {p} Sandstone、{p} 産の本物の虚無石もあるぞ！
From the Bottom#009.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#010.src: Human, you there! If you're interested in smithing, you've found the right place! ...so long as you like drinking Dwarven drinks. I'm looking for bottlecap sets in exchange for these.
From the Bottom#010.dst: そこの人間！鍛冶に興味があるなら、ここで正解だ！…ドワーフの酒が好きならな。これと引き換えに王冠のセットを探してるんだ。
From the Bottom#010.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#011.src: What's that look for? Are you new here or something? Never seen a bottlecap collector before? Or is that just your face?
From the Bottom#011.dst: 何だその顔は？新入りか何かか？王冠コレクターを見たことないのか？それとも元からその顔か？
From the Bottom#011.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#012.src: Wh- That! That's! I! How did you! It...It's in pristine condition! There's not a single cap missing! There's not even any dents from the bottle openers!!!
From the Bottom#012.dst: な――それ！それは！俺！どうやって！こ…完璧な保存状態だ！王冠が一つも欠けてない！栓抜きの凹みすらない！！！
From the Bottom#012.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#013.src: There's no way you got those in person! You can't possibly understand the significance of what you're holding!! I! NEED! THEM!
From the Bottom#013.dst: 自分で集めたはずがない！手にしてる物の価値が分かるわけない！！俺には！それが！必要だ！
From the Bottom#013.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#014.src: Here! My rarest metal! Take them! Take them and give me those bottlecaps! I've got to complete my collection!! Give it! Give it! Give it give it give it give it NOW!
From the Bottom#014.dst: ほら！一番珍しい金属だ！持ってけ！持ってって、その王冠をよこせ！コレクションを完成させなきゃ！！よこせ！よこせ！よこせよこせよこせ、今すぐ！
From the Bottom#014.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#015.src: ...er. Ahem. I got carried away there. But...those bottlecaps are from the very first Dogun Festival. It wasn't even held in Courag at the time these were made!
From the Bottom#015.dst: …ええと。ゴホン。つい熱くなった。でも…その王冠は第一回 Dogun Festival の物なんだ。作られた当時は、まだ Courag で開かれてすらいなかった！
From the Bottom#015.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#016.src: I'd love to talk about them more, but I can't spend too long on the sale, or other customers might go away. But you got a good deal with that Jasplite I gave you!
From the Bottom#016.dst: もっと語りたいが、一つの商売に時間をかけすぎると他の客が帰っちまう。でも、渡した Jasplite はいい取引だったぞ！
From the Bottom#016.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#017.src: Come to think of it, some guy wanted that stuff, but he didn't even have a plain ol' sodapop cap on him! I think he's right close by. Maybe you'd have some interest in what you're selling instead.
From the Bottom#017.dst: そういや、あれを欲しがってた奴がいたが、普通の炭酸の王冠一つ持ってなかった！すぐ近くにいると思う。お前の売り物に興味を持つかもな。
From the Bottom#017.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#018.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy some [Molten Jasplite Ingots]. Dorroc is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#018.dst: {p} で [Molten Jasplite Ingots] を買いたい人を探す。Dorroc は {~}, {~}, -{~} にいる

From the Bottom#019.src: Hm...a human trader? Well, I've heard of you, but I hope it isn't just the standard fare from you.
From the Bottom#019.dst: ふむ…人間の商人か？噂は聞いているが、ありきたりの品でないことを願うよ。
From the Bottom#019.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#020.src: Yes, I've seen quite a few of your type to this bazaar- Using the community forges and smithing tables in all. You seem to have metals in bulk...
From the Bottom#020.dst: ああ、このバザーで君のような者は大勢見た――共用の炉や鍛冶台を使ってな。金属を大量に持っているようだが…
From the Bottom#020.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#021.src: ...but probably ninety-eight out of a hundred of the metal ingots I've seen humans use have been trash quality! Worthless only for practice! I seek only the finest metals, you see.
From the Bottom#021.dst: …だが人間が使う金属インゴットは、百のうち九十八はゴミ同然だ！練習にしか使えん！私が求めるのは最上の金属だけなのだよ。
From the Bottom#021.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#022.src: ...so, of course, you have to prove me wrong by having MOLTEN JASPLITE?! Oh, you must have gotten that from Dobile. Wouldn't have taken you as a bottlecap collector!
From the Bottom#022.dst: …なのに、よりによって MOLTEN JASPLITE を出して私の鼻を明かすとは？！ああ、Dobile から手に入れたのだな。君が王冠コレクターとは！
From the Bottom#022.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#023.src: I've been pestering him for a while about his stock. The metal of the Unseen Blade is very valuable, you see. It's fragile, yes...
From the Bottom#023.dst: 彼の在庫をずっとせがんでいたのだ。Unseen Blade の金属は非常に貴重なのだよ。脆いのは確かだが…
From the Bottom#023.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#024.src: ...but to wield it is to channel the power of Ockar the Unseen Blade himself! The wartime taskmaster who cowed a hundred demons with a mere dagger!
From the Bottom#024.dst: …それを振るえば、Ockar the Unseen Blade 本人の力を引き出せる！短剣一本で百の悪魔を震え上がらせた戦時の監督官だ！
From the Bottom#024.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#025.src: Sneaking behind the lines of the enemy, braving blistering heat! Remaining as a shadow, and cutting through sheer earth and magma without flinching!!
From the Bottom#025.dst: 敵陣の背後に忍び込み、焼けつく熱に立ち向かう！影に徹し、硬い岩盤もマグマもひるまず斬り裂く！！
From the Bottom#025.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#026.src: ...erm, yes. Anyways! For that, I can give you nothing less than my rarest stock. A Golemlus Power Core. If Qira found out I had this, I'd be worse off than a dead man.
From the Bottom#026.dst: …えー、ゴホン。とにかく！その対価に、最も希少な在庫を渡そう。Golemlus Power Core だ。これを持っているのが Qira に知れたら、死ぬよりひどい目に遭う。
From the Bottom#026.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#027.src: She keeps the secrets of those creatures under lock and key- and it must be the ticket to unlocking that particular mystery. Treasure this, human! It is no mere Corkian battery.
From the Bottom#027.dst: 彼女はあの生物の秘密を厳重に隠している――これがその謎を解く鍵に違いない。大切にしたまえ、人間！ただの Corkus 製の電池ではないぞ。
From the Bottom#027.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#028.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Golemlus Power Cell]. Lodog is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#028.dst: {p} で [Golemlus Power Cell] を買いたい人を探す。Lodog は {~}, {~}, -{~} にいる

From the Bottom#029.src: Right chief, what can I do ya for? I got all kinds'a machines here. One of 'em's gotta catch your eye, y'hear?
From the Bottom#029.dst: よう大将、何にするかい？ここにはいろんな機械があるぜ。どれか一つは目に留まるはずさ、な？
From the Bottom#029.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#030.src: I jury-rigged this juicer! Put a lemon inside, give it some, heheh, juice, and you'll get yourself lemon juice in a jiff!
From the Bottom#030.dst: おいらのお手製ジューサーだ！レモンを入れて、へへ、パワーを搾れば一瞬でレモンジュース！
From the Bottom#030.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#031.src: Or how 'bout this coin-shooter? Turn the crank and this'll spit out any coin-sized object like nobody's business. Just, uh, don't aim it at any windows, unless you really hate that window.
From the Bottom#031.dst: それともこのコイン発射機はどうだい？ハンドルを回せば、コインくらいの物なら何でも猛烈に撃ち出すぜ。ただ、窓には向けんなよ。その窓がよっぽど嫌いなら別だがな。
From the Bottom#031.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#032.src: ...what? Oh, I see. You think you got somethin' that'll interest ME instead of the other way round. I gotcha. Well, lemme see it a sec.
From the Bottom#032.dst: …何だって？ああ、なるほど。逆に、おいらが興味を持ちそうな物を持ってるってわけか。分かった。ちょいと見せてみな。
From the Bottom#032.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#033.src: ...okay. I can't make heads or tails a' this thing. What'd you say it was again? Don't tell me this is some Corkus gadget from that not-so-{p}!
From the Bottom#033.dst: …よし。こいつはさっぱり分からん。何だって言ったっけ？まさか、あの大したことねえ {p} の Corkus 製ガジェットじゃねえだろうな！
From the Bottom#033.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#034.src: ...a... A Golemlus Power Core...? This... hot DOG! Yahaaah, I'd heard about these wacko golem thingies ages ago, I always wanted to take 'em apart! Aw hell, but this is an opportunity!
From the Bottom#034.dst: …ゴ…Golemlus Power Core…？こいつは…たまげた！ヤッホー、そういうイカれたゴーレムの話は昔から聞いてて、ずっとバラしてみたかったんだ！こりゃチャンスだぜ！
From the Bottom#034.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#035.src: Gotta say, for something that came from that Hive it's a lot less purple and black and spidery-all-over than I expected. The complexity...this has gotta be the real deal, but...
From the Bottom#035.dst: 言っとくが、あの巣から来た物にしちゃ、思ったより紫でも黒でもねえし、クモっぽくもねえ。この複雑さ…こいつは本物に違いねえが…
From the Bottom#035.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#036.src: Feels like someone else made this. That Qira lady doesn't seem like the handsy type, and this is something like {~} mechanics, {~} magic. Just seems out of character.
From the Bottom#036.dst: 別の誰かが作った気がする。あの Qira って女は自分で手を動かすタイプじゃなさそうだし、これは機械が {~}、魔法が {~} って感じだ。どうも彼女らしくねえ。
From the Bottom#036.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#037.src: Ah, but I'm gettin' away from myself. Tell ya what- prob'ly went through a lotta trouble ta get this, and that means you got guts. You got bravery. You got STONES, human!
From the Bottom#037.dst: おっと、話がそれた。こうしよう――これを手に入れるのにさぞ苦労したろう。つまり、お前には根性がある。勇気がある。肝っ玉があるぜ、人間！
From the Bottom#037.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#038.src: So, how 'bout these Ice Drake Scales then? It fits a brave soul like you, it does! Take 'em with pride, there!
From the Bottom#038.dst: じゃあ、この Ice Drake Scales はどうだい？お前みたいな勇敢な奴にぴったりさ！誇りを持って持ってきな！
From the Bottom#038.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#039.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy the Ice Drake Scales. Mastro is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#039.dst: {p} で Ice Drake Scales を買いたい人を探す。Mastro は {~}, {~}, -{~} にいる

From the Bottom#040.src: Ardent Magma Crystals for sale! Pure, {~}! Accept no substitutes, unless you're paying in emeralds, in which case kindly substitute...a lot of them!!
From the Bottom#040.dst: Ardent Magma Crystal 売ってるぞ！純度 {~}！代用品はお断り、エメラルド払いなら話は別、その時はぜひ代わりに…たっぷり頼む！！
From the Bottom#040.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#041.src: Human! You have a keen eye for prices and values! I can tell by that glint in your eye- a real MAN's spirit! Even if you aren't a man, your spirit shines all the same as a man...!
From the Bottom#041.dst: 人間！お前には値段と価値を見抜く鋭い目がある！その目の輝きで分かる――真の漢の魂だ！漢でなくとも、その魂は漢と同じく輝いている…！
From the Bottom#041.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#042.src: A SALES MAN! YES! Macho and brave! Chiseled and strong! Strong enough to carry {~} Liquid Emeralds to trade for this brilliant Ardent Magma Crystal!
From the Bottom#042.dst: セールス漢！そうだ！マッチョで勇敢！彫りが深くて力強い！この輝く Ardent Magma Crystal と交換する液体エメラルド {~} 個を運べるほど強い！
From the Bottom#042.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#043.src: ...but hold on a moment. Hold on just one moment. Do I detect...a vein of ICE in that manly aura? A chill, pushing against that spirit of market machismo?
From the Bottom#043.dst: …だが待て。ちょっと待て。その漢のオーラに…氷の筋を感じるぞ？市場のマッチョ魂に逆らう冷気を？
From the Bottom#043.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#044.src: YES, I DO! Human, you have Ice Drake Scales! I needn't see them to be sure! I was right about you from the start- Such burning passion!!
From the Bottom#044.dst: 感じる！人間、お前は Ice Drake Scales を持っている！見なくても分かる！最初から見込み通りだ――なんと燃える情熱！！
From the Bottom#044.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#045.src: AND SUCH NAIVETE! Let me strengthen your MIND! Ice Drake Scales are indicative of a great challenge having been overcome! A truly macho trophy of accomplishment!
From the Bottom#045.dst: そして、なんと純真！その心を鍛えてやろう！Ice Drake Scales は偉大な試練を乗り越えた証！真にマッチョな功績のトロフィーだ！
From the Bottom#045.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#046.src: To tame Ice Drakes required UNBREAKABLE will! To overcome the sheerest cold with MACHO HEAT! And to outshine demons of lava and flame with that same determination! Those scales represent such resilience!
From the Bottom#046.dst: Ice Drake を手懐けるには不屈の意志が要る！極寒をマッチョな熱で乗り越える！その決意で溶岩と炎の悪魔にも勝る輝きを放つ！その鱗はそんな不屈の証だ！
From the Bottom#046.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#047.src: And yet...I must wonder. Such a fiery spirit you have- THOSE SCALES HOLD YOU BACK! Your spirit cannot be contained in such a manner!
From the Bottom#047.dst: だが…思うのだ。お前はそれほど燃える魂を持っている――その鱗はお前を縛っている！お前の魂はそんな形で閉じ込められはしない！
From the Bottom#047.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#048.src: DISRESPECT YOURSELF NO LONGER! I DEMAND YOU HAND OVER THOSE SCALES! But you will not leave empty-handed, no no, friend!
From the Bottom#048.dst: もう自分を軽んじるな！その鱗を渡してもらおう！だが手ぶらでは帰さん、いやいや、友よ！
From the Bottom#048.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#049.src: You have ignited my passion as a salesman, so I shall present you with one of my own greatest accomplishments! For a spirit so WHITE HOT, only an ARDENT MAGMA CRYSTAL is fitting!
From the Bottom#049.dst: お前はセールス漢としての俺の情熱に火をつけた、だから俺の最高傑作の一つを贈ろう！白熱する魂には、ARDENT MAGMA CRYSTAL こそふさわしい！
From the Bottom#049.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#050.src: YES! Your soul shines brighter than the shimmer of EIGHT-HUNDRED-MILLION EMERALDS! Forever may your spirit BURN, human!
From the Bottom#050.dst: そうだ！お前の魂は八億個のエメラルドの輝きより眩しい！永遠に魂を燃やせ、人間！
From the Bottom#050.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#051.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy an [Ardent Magma Crystal]. Dohstaj is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#051.dst: {p} で [Ardent Magma Crystal] を買いたい人を探す。Dohstaj は {~}, {~}, -{~} にいる

From the Bottom#053.dst: …Mastro の叫びが聞こえた。彼…とても情熱的。
From the Bottom#053.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#054.src: ...he's married to his work. Would I were his.
From the Bottom#054.dst: …彼は仕事と結婚してる。私がその仕事ならいいのに。
From the Bottom#054.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#055.src: ...but business first. Wartime artifacts for sale.
From the Bottom#055.dst: …でも商売が先。戦時の遺物、売ってるよ。
From the Bottom#055.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#056.src: ...priciest thing is a Dogun Flameshooter. Practically invaluable. You want it?
From the Bottom#056.dst: …一番高いのは Dogun Flameshooter。値がつけられないほど。欲しい？
From the Bottom#056.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#059.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy the [Dogun Flameshooter]. Syni is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#059.dst: {p} で [Dogun Flameshooter] を買いたい人を探す。Syni は {~}, {~}, -{~} にいる

From the Bottom#060.src: I can't stand this. I can't stand this! SHUT UP, MASTRO! NO ONE CARES ABOUT YOUR SWEATY SPIRIT OR WHATEVER!
From the Bottom#060.dst: もう無理。もう無理！黙って、MASTRO！あんたの汗くさい魂だか何だか、誰も気にしてないから！
From the Bottom#060.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#061.src: MY MACHISMO CANNOT BE CONTAINED! Your aversion only inspires my salesman's spirit! Ardent Magma Crystals! Pure, {~} gold! {~} Liquid Emeralds, {~} off! STRONG bargains!
From the Bottom#061.dst: 俺のマッチョは抑えられん！その嫌悪こそセールス漢の魂を奮い立たせる！Ardent Magma Crystal！純度 {~} の金！液体エメラルド {~} 個、{~} 引き！力強いお買い得！
From the Bottom#061.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#062.src: AAAGH! Stupid, stupid, stupid Dohstaj! I just need him to fork over that stupid Flameshooter and then I can get away from this tripe but he just! Won't! DO IT!
From the Bottom#062.dst: ああもう！バカ、バカ、バカ Dohstaj！あのバカな Flameshooter さえ渡してくれれば、こんなくだらない所から離れられるのに、あの人は！全然！渡さない！
From the Bottom#062.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#063.src: No, look, human! Can't you see the kind of stress I'm under?! I don't care about your Flameshooter, I need to get my hands on Dohstaj's Flameshooter!
From the Bottom#063.dst: 違う、聞いて、人間！私がどれだけストレス抱えてるか分からない？！あんたの Flameshooter はどうでもいい、Dohstaj の Flameshooter が要るの！
From the Bottom#063.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#065.src: ...wait. Wait wait wait that's Dohstaj's Flameshooter how in the world did you get it what what WHAT! How did you snap him out of his...emotions?!
From the Bottom#065.dst: …待って。待って待って待って、それ Dohstaj の Flameshooter じゃない、どうやって手に入れたの、何何何！どうやってあの人を…感情から引き戻したの？！
From the Bottom#065.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#066.src: I've been trying to get a hold of that for a week straight! I already have the perfect trade lined up! Please, hear me out!
From the Bottom#066.dst: 丸一週間ずっと手に入れようとしてたの！最高の取引ももう用意してある！お願い、聞いて！
From the Bottom#066.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#067.src: I have here the Scepter of Draani Thunderwill I! Dohstaj only WISHES he could salvage something this juicy! The real, honest-to-goodness staff of the Wartime King!
From the Bottom#067.dst: ここにあるのは Draani Thunderwill 一世の笏よ！Dohstaj じゃこんなお宝は夢のまた夢！戦時の王の、正真正銘本物の杖なんだから！
From the Bottom#067.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#068.src: A war relic for a war relic. It's only a fair trade! Just be real careful- a theif's been skulking in the yellow stall by the bank trying to steal it from me.
From the Bottom#068.dst: 戦争の遺物には戦争の遺物。公平な取引でしょ！ただ気をつけて――銀行のそばの黄色い屋台に泥棒が潜んでて、これを盗もうとしてるの。
From the Bottom#068.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#069.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy [Draani Thunderwill's Scepter]. Yobon is behind the stone walls at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#069.dst: {p} で [Draani Thunderwill's Scepter] を買いたい人を探す。Yobon は {~}, {~}, -{~} の石壁の裏にいる

From the Bottom#070.src: ...so. I saw you talking with Syni.
From the Bottom#070.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#071.src: Pfft. Thief? I'm an honest man. Just following the old footsteps.
From the Bottom#071.dst: ふん。泥棒？俺は正直者だ。昔ながらの足跡をたどってるだけさ。
From the Bottom#071.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#072.src: I know you have the Scepter. I'd have thumped you and taken you if you were a Dwarf.
From the Bottom#072.dst: 笏を持ってるのは知ってる。お前がドワーフなら、ぶん殴って奪ってたところだ。
From the Bottom#072.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#073.src: But how 'bout we work out a deal, instead? Take this tablet.
From the Bottom#073.dst: だが、代わりに取引といこうか？この石板をやる。
From the Bottom#073.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#074.src: It'll explain everything. Dwarven History...if you can read it. I can. Won't let loose my secrets for free though.
From the Bottom#074.dst: これで全部分かる。ドワーフの歴史…読めればな。俺は読める。だが秘密をタダで明かす気はない。
From the Bottom#074.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#075.src: Hand over the Scepter, and I'll hand over the tablet.
From the Bottom#075.dst: 笏を渡せば、石板を渡す。
From the Bottom#075.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#076.src: I won't translate it for you, but I'm sure there's some egghead who'll get back to you on what it means in...ten years or so.
From the Bottom#076.dst: 訳してはやらんが、どこかの学者先生が…十年かそこらで意味を教えてくれるだろうよ。
From the Bottom#076.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#077.src: Good things come to those who wait for others to do the work for 'em, as they say.
From the Bottom#077.dst: 他人が仕事を片付けるのを待つ者に福来る、ってな。
From the Bottom#077.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#078.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy your [Eons-Lost Dwarven History Tablet]. Nakoba is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#078.dst: {p} で自分の [Eons-Lost Dwarven History Tablet] を買いたい人を探す。Nakoba は {~}, {~}, -{~} にいる

From the Bottom#079.src: Well, you've been busy, I see! You've been working this bazaar like a champion!
From the Bottom#079.dst: やあ、忙しくしてたみたいだね！このバザーを見事に渡り歩いてるじゃないか！
From the Bottom#079.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#080.src: I ought to tell my friends up at the topside shops- they really respect traders who know their way around a deal. You should be able to buy and use more items from the armories!
From the Bottom#080.dst: 上のお店の友達に伝えておかなきゃ――取引上手な商人をすごく尊敬してるんだ。武具店でもっといろんな物を買って使えるようになるはずだよ！
From the Bottom#080.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#081.src: I... haven't had such luck unfortunately. I think you might've picked the place clean, eheh. Don't suppose you've got one last deal up your sleeve, huh?
From the Bottom#081.dst: 僕は…残念ながらそんな運はなくてね。ここ、君が根こそぎさらったんじゃないかな、えへへ。まさか最後の取引を隠し持ってたりしないよね？
From the Bottom#081.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#082.src: Oh, really? Hah, I was just joking about that, but if you really do have an offer, go ahead and lay it on me!
From the Bottom#082.dst: え、本当？はは、冗談のつもりだったけど、本当に何かあるなら、ぜひ見せてよ！
From the Bottom#082.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#087.src: THAT'S ANCIENT HISTORY! FORMATIVE ANCIENT HISTORY!
From the Bottom#087.dst: これは古代史だ！起源にまつわる古代史だよ！
From the Bottom#087.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#088.src: I recognize those runes, they're ancient Dwarven glyphs! This is slab number three! We already have the first, second, and fourth tablets, my team and I- this would finish the collection!
From the Bottom#088.dst: このルーンは知ってる、古代ドワーフの文字だ！これは三枚目の石板！一、二、四枚目は僕とチームがもう持ってる――これで全部揃う！
From the Bottom#088.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#089.src: I! I! I! Take! TAKE EVERYTHING I HAVE! TAKE IT ALL, I NEED THAT! I NEED TO DISCOVER THOSE ANCIENT SECRETS!
From the Bottom#089.dst: ぼ、僕の！持ってって！全部持ってって！それが要るんだ！古代の秘密を解き明かすんだ！
From the Bottom#089.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#090.src: AH! AHAHAHAHA! THE HISTORY! THE STORIES! THE EVERYTHING! IT'S BETTER THAN THE SMELL OF TROLL HAIR! AHAHAHAAAHAHHAHHAHAAAAAH!
From the Bottom#090.dst: あっ！アハハハハ！この歴史！この物語！このすべて！Troll Hair の匂いよりすごい！アハハハアアハハハハアアア！
From the Bottom#090.speaker: Nakoba
